systems.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system within the Hospital Management System (HMS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Health with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications
systems.tiers: first phase launched 11 May 2026 at Al-Nao hospital in Khartoum State and the diagnostic centre of Gedaref hospital, with gradual expansion to health institutions in other states intended; named as a component, what it does is not described

note: A CRVS system is named among the components of a hospital management system launched at two hospitals, with no description of what it does or whether a birth or death is registered there; a name alone gives no fact.
